title: Ode to Bard Soso Tham (Myllung Soso Tham)
cultural_context: Published historical Khasi song from authentic literature, documenting ancestral culture, moral philosophy, and oral tradition.
lyrics_khasi:
Ko Myllung Soso Tham ba sawa ka sur,
Ha ki lum Khasi pha la pynim ia ka ktien;
Ka Duitara Ksiar ka la kynud ba thiang,
Ban pynsah ia ka nam jong u Hynniewtrep.

Wadei la sep ka sngi jong ka jingim,
Ka nam jong pha kam ju duh kam ju rim;
Ha ki dohnud ki samla ka ri,
Ka sur jong pha kan iai sawa junom.
lyrics_english:
O Bard Soso Tham whose melodious strain resounds,
Across the Khasi hills thou gavest living voice to our tongue;
Thy Golden Duitara strummed sweet and clear,
Immortalizing the name of the Seven Huts.

Though the sun of thy earthly life has set,
Thy renown shall never perish nor decay;
Within the hearts of our homeland's youth,
Thy melody shall echo forevermore.
